title: Resume Layout Overrides
description: Bounded layout knobs the tailoring agent may adjust before resorting to dropping content on overflow. Defaults match the tightened Jake's-resume baseline; ranges define how far the render pipeline will let a caller push font size and margins.

font_size_pt.description: Body text size in points. 10.0 is the readability floor; below it a resume starts reading as visibly crammed.

margin_in.description: Uniform page margin (all four sides) in inches. 0.4 is the practical floor — most printers can't reliably print closer to the edge, and tighter margins read as cramped.
